```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(learnr)
library(dplyr)

library(tibble)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(magrittr)
library(rsconnect)
library(base64enc)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
options(tutorial.storage = NULL)

# Raw data the scientist left behind

day1_data <- tibble::tibble(
  experiment_id = c("exp_001", "exp_002", NA, "exp_003", "exp_004", "exp_005"),
  timestamp     = c(
    "2025-07-01 09:00:00",
    "2025-07-01 09:05:00",
    "2025-07-01 09:10:00",
  "202507-01 9-15-00",   # deliberately malformed
    "2025-07-01 09:20:00",
    "2025-07-01 09:25:00"
  ),
  comment       = c(
    "##$$",
    "U09NRVRISU5H", 
    "1265435O27",
    "HFRSAVW7Dt",
    "####$%",
    "jiiflpa_"
  ),
  value         = c(12.5, 13.7, 14.1, 11.9, 15.2, 12.7)
)

inventory <- tibble::tibble(
  item_code = c(
    "SE-2025-001", "BX-2024-007", "lE-2025-002", "RE-2025-003", 
    "BX-2022-099", "XV-2025-010", "AX-2025-005", "RE-2024-015",
    "SE-2025-011", "lE-2025-012", "VO-2025-013", "XV-2025-014"
  ),
  measurement = c(42.1, 75.2, 49.7, 38.9, 120.4, 45.3, 33.8, 60.1, 47.0, 25.5, 49.9, 20.1),
  month = c(
    "August", "July", "August", "August", "August", 
    "June", "August", "August", "July", "July", "August", "June"
  )
)




# Safety Manifest
# Only items listed here were cleared for final use
safety_manifest <- tibble::tibble(
  ID = c(
    "SE", "RE", "AX", "lE", "GT", "BX", "CZ", "MD", "QT", "LP", "VO", "XV"
  ),
  clearance_level = c(
    "high", "high", "medium", "high", "high", "low", "medium", "low", "high", "medium", "high", "high"
  )
)

coordinates <- tibble::tibble(
  lat = c(53.4679, 53.4695, 53.4655, 53.4622, 53.4638, 53.4650, 53.4636),
  lon = c(-2.2330, -2.2345, -2.2320, -2.2338, -2.2342, -2.2328, -2.2347),
  tag = c("MQlV", "SU4", "STg==", "gS0l", NA, "??4V", "SU*4")
)



# Base64 fragments from earlier days
# "Something" -> "U29tZXRoaW5n"
# "Hidden"    -> "SGlkZGVu"
# "IN KILBURN" -> "SU4gS0lMQlVSTg=="

```


#### Solution to Challenge 1
```{r day1-solution, exercise=TRUE}
# Filter out rows with missing experiment_id
fragment <- day1_data |> 
  filter(!is.na(experiment_id)) |> 
  # Parse timestamp and extract valid fragments from comment
  mutate(
    time = parse_date_time(timestamp, orders = c("ymd HMS", "Ymd HMS")),
    fragment = ifelse(str_detect(comment, "^[A-Za-z0-9]+$"), comment, NA_character_)
  )  |> 
  # Keep only rows with valid time and fragment
  filter(!is.na(time), !is.na(fragment))

# Show the resulting fragment
fragment
```

#### Solution to Challenge 2
```{r day2-solution, exercise=TRUE}
fragment <- inventory |> 
  filter(measurement < 50) |>
  # Step 1: split item_code into type, year, id
  separate(item_code, into = c("ID", "year", "number"), sep = "-") |> 
  
  # Step 2: join with safety_manifest to keep only approved types
  inner_join(safety_manifest, by = "ID") |> 
  
  # Step 3: filter for August and measurement < 50
  filter( month == "August", clearance_level == "high") |>
  
  # Step 4: extract the type column and collapse into a single string
  pull(ID) |> 
  paste0(collapse = "")
  
fragment
```



#### Solution to Challenge 3
```{r day3-solution, exercise=TRUE}
# Step 1: Filter valid tags
valid_points <- coordinates |> 
  filter(!is.na(tag)) |> 
  filter(str_detect(tag, "^[A-Za-z0-9=]+$"))

# Step 2: Plot valid points
ggplot(valid_points, aes(x = lon, y = lat, label = tag)) +
  geom_point(color = "blue", size = 3) +
  geom_text(vjust = -0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Field Sites — Valid Tags Only",
       subtitle = "Observe the west-to-east alignment to reveal the fragment",
       x = "Longitude", y = "Latitude")

# Step 3: Combine tags from west to east
fragment <- valid_points |> 
  arrange(lon) |>        # order from west (lowest lon) to east (highest lon)
  pull(tag) |>           # extract the tags
  paste(collapse = "")   # combine into one string


# Step 4: Print the resulting fragment
fragment
```


#### Solution to Challenge 4
```{r day4-solution, exercise=TRUE}
# Step 1: Assign the encoded fragments
encoded1 <- "U09NRVRISU5H"
encoded2 <- "SElEREVO"
encoded3 <- "SU4gS0lMQlVSTg=="

# Step 2: Decode each
decoded1 <- encoded1 |> base64decode() |> rawToChar()
decoded2 <- encoded2 |> base64decode() |> rawToChar()
decoded3 <- encoded3 |> base64decode() |> rawToChar()

# Step 3: Combine into one sentence
final_message <- paste(decoded1, decoded2, decoded3)

final_message
```
